1	/**
2	 * resolve-actor.ts — Cloudflare Workers port of the Express actorMiddleware.
3	 *
4	 * Resolves the authenticated actor from a Web API `Request` object without
5	 * depending on any Node-only modules (`node:crypto`, Express types, etc.).
6	 *
7	 * SHA-256 hashing uses the Web Crypto API (`crypto.subtle`) which is available
8	 * in both the Workers runtime and modern Node.js (>= 19 with global `crypto`).
9	 *
10	 * BetterAuth session lookup is skipped for the Workers deployment — the CF
11	 * Worker authenticates via Bearer tokens (agent JWTs, agent API keys, and
12	 * board API keys). UI sessions that rely on HTTP-only cookies must go through
13	 * BetterAuth's own `/api/auth/*` handler, which is mounted separately.
14	 */
15	
16	import { and, eq, isNull } from "drizzle-orm";
17	import type { Db } from "@paperclipai/db";
18	import { agentApiKeys, agents, authUsers, boardApiKeys, companyMemberships, instanceUserRoles } from "@paperclipai/db";
19	import type { ActorContext } from "../../../../server/src/http/types.js";
20	import { verifyLocalAgentJwt } from "../../../../server/src/agent-auth-jwt.js";
21	
22	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
23	// Internal helpers
24	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	
26	/** SHA-256 hash a token using the Web Crypto API, returning a lowercase hex string. */
27	async function hashToken(token: string): Promise<string> {
28	  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(token));
29	  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
30	    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
31	    .join("");
32	}
33	
34	/**
35	 * Resolve the board actor memberships for a given userId.
36	 * Queries `companyMemberships` and `instanceUserRoles` in parallel.
37	 */
38	async function resolveBoardAccess(db: Db, userId: string) {
39	  const [user, memberships, adminRole] = await Promise.all([
40	    db
41	      .select({ id: authUsers.id, name: authUsers.name, email: authUsers.email })
42	      .from(authUsers)
43	      .where(eq(authUsers.id, userId))
44	      .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null),
45	    db
46	      .select({
47	        companyId: companyMemberships.companyId,
48	        membershipRole: companyMemberships.membershipRole,
49	        status: companyMemberships.status,
50	      })
51	      .from(companyMemberships)
52	      .where(
53	        and(
54	          eq(companyMemberships.principalType, "user"),
55	          eq(companyMemberships.principalId, userId),
56	          eq(companyMemberships.status, "active"),
57	        ),
58	      ),
59	    db
60	      .select({ id: instanceUserRoles.id })
61	      .from(instanceUserRoles)
62	      .where(and(eq(instanceUserRoles.userId, userId), eq(instanceUserRoles.role, "instance_admin")))
63	      .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null),
64	  ]);
65	
66	  return {
67	    user,
68	    companyIds: memberships.map((row) => row.companyId),
69	    memberships,
70	    isInstanceAdmin: Boolean(adminRole),
71	  };
72	}
73	
74	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
75	// Public API
76	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
77	
78	export type DeploymentMode = "local_trusted" | "authenticated";
79	
80	/**
81	 * Resolves the actor from the incoming Web API `Request`.
82	 *
83	 * Resolution order:
84	 * 1. `local_trusted` mode → always returns a local implicit board actor (no DB
85	 *    queries needed).
86	 * 2. `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header:
87	 *    a. Board API key (pcp_board_* tokens stored in `boardApiKeys`).
88	 *    b. Agent API key (hash stored in `agentApiKeys`).
89	 *    c. Agent JWT (HMAC-signed token; verified without DB lookup).
90	 * 3. No Bearer token or unrecognised token → returns `null` (unauthenticated).
91	 *
92	 * Note: Cookie-based BetterAuth sessions are not resolved here. The Cloudflare
93	 * deployment uses the BetterAuth `/api/auth/*` handler separately, and the UI
94	 * exchanges the session cookie for a Board API key on first visit.
95	 */
96	export async function resolveActorFromRequest(
97	  request: Request,
98	  db: Db,
99	  opts: { deploymentMode: DeploymentMode },
100	): Promise<ActorContext | null> {
101	  // 1. Local trusted mode — skip all auth checks.
102	  if (opts.deploymentMode === "local_trusted") {
103	    return {
104	      type: "board",
105	      source: "local_implicit",
106	      userId: "local-board",
107	      userName: "Local Board",
108	      userEmail: null,
109	      isInstanceAdmin: true,
110	    };
111	  }
112	
113	  const runIdHeader = request.headers.get("x-paperclip-run-id") ?? undefined;
114	
115	  // 2. Bearer token
116	  const authHeader = request.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";
117	  if (!authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
118	    return null;
119	  }
120	
121	  const token = authHeader.slice("bearer ".length).trim();
122	  if (!token) return null;
123	
124	  // 2a. Board API key — stored as pcp_board_* with a hash in boardApiKeys table.
125	  const tokenHash = await hashToken(token);
126	  const boardKey = await db
127	    .select()
128	    .from(boardApiKeys)
129	    .where(and(eq(boardApiKeys.keyHash, tokenHash), isNull(boardApiKeys.revokedAt)))
130	    .then((rows) => {
131	      const now = new Date();
132	      return rows.find((row) => !row.expiresAt || row.expiresAt.getTime() > now.getTime()) ?? null;
133	    });
134	
135	  if (boardKey) {
136	    const access = await resolveBoardAccess(db, boardKey.userId);
137	    if (access.user) {
138	      // Touch lastUsedAt asynchronously — don't block the response.
139	      void db
140	        .update(boardApiKeys)
141	        .set({ lastUsedAt: new Date() })
142	        .where(eq(boardApiKeys.id, boardKey.id));
143	
144	      return {
145	        type: "board",
146	        source: "board_key",
147	        userId: boardKey.userId,
148	        userName: access.user.name ?? null,
149	        userEmail: access.user.email ?? null,
150	        companyIds: access.companyIds,
151	        memberships: access.memberships.map((m) => ({ ...m, membershipRole: m.membershipRole ?? "" })),
152	        isInstanceAdmin: access.isInstanceAdmin,
153	        keyId: boardKey.id,
154	        runId: runIdHeader,
155	      };
156	    }
157	  }
158	
159	  // 2b. Agent API key — hash stored in agentApiKeys.
160	  const agentKey = await db
161	    .select()
162	    .from(agentApiKeys)
163	    .where(and(eq(agentApiKeys.keyHash, tokenHash), isNull(agentApiKeys.revokedAt)))
164	    .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null);
165	
166	  if (agentKey) {
167	    const agentRecord = await db
168	      .select()
169	      .from(agents)
170	      .where(eq(agents.id, agentKey.agentId))
171	      .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null);
172	
173	    if (
174	      agentRecord &&
175	      agentRecord.status !== "terminated" &&
176	      agentRecord.status !== "pending_approval"
177	    ) {
178	      // Touch lastUsedAt asynchronously.
179	      void db
180	        .update(agentApiKeys)
181	        .set({ lastUsedAt: new Date() })
182	        .where(eq(agentApiKeys.id, agentKey.id));
183	
184	      return {
185	        type: "agent",
186	        source: "agent_key",
187	        agentId: agentKey.agentId,
188	        companyId: agentKey.companyId,
189	        keyId: agentKey.id,
190	        runId: runIdHeader,
191	      };
192	    }
193	    // Key exists but agent is terminated/pending — fall through to return null.
194	    return null;
195	  }
196	
197	  // 2c. Agent JWT — verified with HMAC secret; no DB lookup needed for
198	  //     the signature, but we validate the agent still exists and is active.
199	  const claims = verifyLocalAgentJwt(token);
200	  if (claims) {
201	    const agentRecord = await db
202	      .select()
203	      .from(agents)
204	      .where(eq(agents.id, claims.sub))
205	      .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null);
206	
207	    if (
208	      agentRecord &&
209	      agentRecord.companyId === claims.company_id &&
210	      agentRecord.status !== "terminated" &&
211	      agentRecord.status !== "pending_approval"
212	    ) {
213	      return {
214	        type: "agent",
215	        source: "agent_jwt",
216	        agentId: claims.sub,
217	        companyId: claims.company_id,
218	        runId: runIdHeader ?? claims.run_id ?? undefined,
219	      };
220	    }
221	  }
222	
223	  // Unrecognised or invalid token.
224	  return null;
225	}
